system.requirements: You have Concealment or at least Lesser Cover.
system.effect:
Attempt one Stealth check, compared separately against the Awareness of each creature that can currently locate you and from which you have Concealment or at least Lesser Cover. Apply the following results separately to each creature:
Critical Success or Success You become Hidden to that creature.
Failure Your awareness state relative to that creature does not change.
Critical Failure As Failure, and you are Wrong-Footed to that creature until your next Opportunity.
Note on Existing Stealth: You remain Hidden or Undetected to creatures to which you already had that state. Hide does not make a creature forget that you are present.
Note on Cover and Concealment: Check these separately for each creature. You cannot use Hide to become Hidden from a creature against which you lack the required Cover or Concealment.
